intro: These tightly bound papers were recovered from a crate amidst a ruined caravan in eastern Mulgore. They detail the operations of the Venture Company, confirming the predatory cartel's illegal strip-mining ventures within the tauren homeland.

p: Discovered packed atop mined ore and minerals in the remnants of a ransacked wagon, these documents expose the scale of the Venture Company's intrusion into Mulgore. Known across Kalimdor for ruthless deforestation and uncontrolled excavation, the goblin-led cartel has quietly set up drilling and mining outposts in the eastern foothills. Morin Cloudstalker and the tauren Outrunners rely on these seized ledgers to gauge the threat to their sacred ancestral plains and rally hunters to drive the trespassers out.
